RARE GEM IN THE VIBRANT MISSION DISTRICT - 1350 SqFt Condo w/ Flex Space

Must see in person to understand the possibilities! This beautifully remodeled condo offers one garage parking space, in-unit washer/dryer, 2 spacious bedrooms plus a versatile flex space for multi-use purposes. Enjoy high ceilings, sophisticated crown molding, rich hardwood floors, elegant bay windows and a private deck overlooking a backyard oasis. The kitchen is beautifully updated and integrated with the family room to create an open floor plan - perfect for cooking and entertaining. Enjoy stainless steel appliances, ample counter/cabinet space and a drawer shaped dishwasher. Finally, a cozy nook at the back of the home - perfect for an office overlooking the fruit trees outside.

Excellent walkability score 98/100! Next to Lost Resort, El Chato, Coffee Movement, Tartine, 24th Street, 5 min to Costco and SF General Hospital. Also, seamless commuter access makes this a rare opportunity you won't want to miss!
